image_description: A close-up photograph of a single, large soap bubble floating against a soft-focus green background. The bubble is spherical and translucent, displaying distinct iridescent color patterns (blues, pinks, greens) on its surface due to light interference. It reflects and distorts the background environment. There are faint, out-of-focus bokeh circles in the background, likely other bubbles or light artifacts.
